run_policy: Use separate external worktrees. Never dispatch code agents concurrently in one checkout. This DAG has no merge/release/deploy authority; no native media engine is in scope.

tasks.title: Lock OBS capture, consent, receipt, and gate sequencing
tasks.accept: Issue #109 and CR040-ARCH-DECISION-20261102.md are authority. Keep replay highlights and full-match recording independently selectable in Settings, but unarmed by default; full-match and microphone default off. Display actual OBS scene/source/audio inventory and require fresh per-session consent; invalidate it on source/settings/session changes. Allow only a selected subset of verified local GSI categories. Make wait/partial/discard post-roll outcomes explicit. ReplayBufferSaved path is the replay receipt; current #110 remains replay-only, and full-match requires a separate StartRecord/StopRecord completion contract. Establish source QA -> integration candidate -> independent runtime QA -> owner gate. No shared runtime edits, merge, release, deployment, or #115 work.

needs: PRs #105 and #88 and issue #108 collision check

tasks.title: Build local authenticated OBS replay-buffer adapter
tasks.accept: Issue #110. Create new files under src-tauri/src/obs_media/ for replay-buffer health, explicit StartReplayBuffer, SaveReplayBuffer, and ReplayBufferSaved path receipts with bounded failures. A successful SaveReplayBuffer acknowledgement is not a saved clip. Serialize in-flight replay saves because the event carries a path but no request ID. This lane is replay-only: do not implement or claim full-match StartRecord/StopRecord. Never log passwords or send media/cloud. Unit/mock protocol tests and draft PR; integrator owns lib.rs/Cargo registration. No observable behavior claims without real OBS Windows receipt.

needs: No shared runtime files may be edited

tasks.title: Review source-only highlight planner PR #116
tasks.accept: Issue #111 / Draft PR #116 contains the pure planner. Independently review its exact head, CI, buffer math, allowlisted local GSI admission, same monotonic clock, session fences, dedupe, queue, and wait/partial/discard post-roll behavior. Do not create a duplicate planner or connect it to shared runtime files. No review receipt means this task is not done.

needs: Review PR #116 and record exact-head CI/review evidence

tasks.title: OBS virtual-camera CV input compatibility and performance spike
tasks.accept: Issue #112. Read-only probe/fixtures under tools/obs-cv-spike/ compare OBS Virtual Camera with DXGI and test source-only Dota capture, aspect/ROI mapping, fullscreen, alt-tab, single/dual display, stale frames, and CPU/RAM/GPU/FPS/T0-T3. Reject desktop/display and webcam capture; unknown source inventory is not proof of privacy. Do not edit capture.rs/dxgi.rs or replace DXGI without real acceptance. If live OBS/Dota is unavailable, state NOT_RUN.

needs: #109 game-only source/privacy and DXGI fallback contract

tasks.title: Build isolated G-Highlights settings, consent, and clip UI
tasks.accept: Issue #113. New components under src/src/highlights/components/ provide independently selectable replay-highlight and full-match Settings modes, event-category subset, selected OBS inventory, audio/mic consent, and wait/partial/discard policy. Both modes are unarmed by default; full-match and microphone are off. Require fresh per-session consent; source/settings changes invalidate it. Reject desktop/webcam/unknown sources and never mutate OBS scenes. The current replay-only #110 adapter cannot activate full-match mode; show unavailable until a separate implementation exists. A request acknowledgement never renders saved; only a receipt may do so.

needs: No fake saved status or native acceptance claim

tasks.title: Independently review source contracts and deterministic fixtures
tasks.accept: Source/fixture portion of #114, after A/B/C/D only. Review exact source SHAs, deterministic auth/reconnect/save fixtures, receipt/path and queue semantics, GSI allowlist/session/clock, source-inventory/privacy consent invalidation, mic-off defaults, and wait/partial/discard outcomes. Label each PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN. This gate is not integration or Windows OBS/Dota/NFR acceptance. Full-match remains NOT_IMPLEMENTED until a separate StartRecord/StopRecord adapter contract and tests exist.

needs: Independent reviewer not involved in implementation

tasks.title: Assemble an unmerged wiring/docs/CI integration candidate
tasks.accept: After source QA, assemble a reviewable candidate PR in an isolated worktree. Scope is wiring/registration, normalized GSI-to-planner bridge, OBS command/receipt-to-UI bridge, Settings/status connection, SSOT documentation/generated graph, and CI updates only. Do not add new recording algorithms or implement full-match recording in this wiring stage. Preserve the full-match setting as unavailable unless a separate StartRecord/StopRecord adapter PR has passed its own source gate. Candidate remains unmerged; bind all evidence to its exact SHA. No Windows runtime pass may be claimed here.

needs: A/B/C/D exact SHAs and required CI

tasks.title: Run independent Windows OBS/Dota/NFR QA on the integration candidate
tasks.accept: Runtime portion of #114, by an independent QA owner, only after the integration candidate exists. Bind results to exact candidate SHA, OBS v5/version/device, Windows/Dota mode and settings. Exercise fresh consent/source-change invalidation, replay event-to-save receipt/path and post-roll policy, OBS reconnect/auth failure, mic-off/forbidden-source behavior, and CPU/RAM/GPU/G-Signal/FPS gates. Report PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN; CI or synthetic fixtures are not UAT. Report full-match as NOT_IMPLEMENTED unless its separate adapter/StopRecord completion contract and implementation have passed source review; do not pass the full CR-040 gate while the owner-directed mode is missing.

needs: Actual Windows OBS/Dota access and independent reviewer

tasks.title: Owner-controlled merge/readiness decision
tasks.accept: Owner-only decision after exact-head CI/PR Gate, resolved reviews, CR040-SOURCE-QA PASS, and CR040-RUNTIME-QA evidence. Reconcile #105/#88/#108 shared paths and verify full-match StopRecord/completion contract is implemented and tested; otherwise readiness remains blocked. This node does not authorize agents to merge. Any merge is owner-controlled and follows protected main gates. No tag, release, deployment, or #115 native work is included.
